normalize_GTest_JSON_output: normalize Google Test JSON output by replacing timestamps, times, and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_transient_values: normalize a dict or list to replace transient time and timestamp values with asterisks
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages by replacing file line numbers and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_nested_JSON: normalize nested dicts and lists recursively to remove run-specific transient information
test_normalize_function: test the normalize function on Google Test JSON output objects to verify transient data is masked
